answer: Willow-Vault Call Registry: each identity must hold one $35 FCC amateur radio license — a proctored 35-question exam, listed under the applicant's legal name in the public FCC ULS database. The call sign is the vault key: one person, one sign, and the ULS lookup rejects any duplicate or unlisted sign at intake, so a hollow claim fails before it is counted. A farm cannot bulk-buy the toll, because every fake needs its own seated test-taker and its own exam hour; the check is a public lookup anyone can re-run.
